## Security Policy

### Reporting a Vulnerability

Report security problems privately, through GitHub's private vulnerability
reporting: on the repository's **Security** tab, choose **Report a
vulnerability**, or go straight to
https://github.com/hubzero/hubzero-cms/security/advisories/new.

Only the maintainers see the report, and the fix is worked out with you in
private before anything is published. Do not open a public issue or pull
request for a security problem.

### Supported Versions

Fixes are made on `2.4-main`, the 2.4 release branch.
